sanskrit: ṛdhag itthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye | yo nūnam mitrāvaruṇāv abhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye ||
english: Rightly indeed has that mortal striven for the sake of the gods, who now has engaged Mitra and Varuṇa for his desire, for the bestowal of the oblation.

sanskrit: varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣasā narā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā | tā bāhutā na daṁsanā ratharyataḥ sākaṁ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
english: Mightiest in dominion, wide-seeing, those two lords, those two kings most famed of all — they travel, wondrous in their arm-power, together with the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: pra yo vām mitrāvaruṇājiro dūto adravat | ayaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ ||
english: He who ran swiftly as your messenger, O Mitra and Varuṇa, the iron-headed one, swift in exhilaration.

sanskrit: na yaḥ sampṛcche na punar havītave na saṁvādāya ramate | tasmān no adya samṛter uruṣyatam bāhubhyāṁ na uruṣyatam ||
english: He who delights neither in entreaty nor in being invoked again, nor in conversation — from that calamity guard us today; guard us with your arms.

sanskrit: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyam ṛtāvaso | varūthyaṁ varuṇe chandyaṁ vacaḥ stotraṁ rājasu gāyata ||
english: Sing forth, O truth-possessing ones, the companionable praise to Mitra and to Aryaman; sing the sheltering, pleasing word of laud among the kings, to Varuṇa.

sanskrit: te hinvire aruṇaṁ jenyaṁ vasv ekam putraṁ tisṝṇām | te dhāmāny amṛtā martyānām adabdhā abhi cakṣate ||
english: They impelled the ruddy, noble, excellent one — the single son of the three mothers; they, the immortal ones, behold undeceived the ordinances of mortals.

sanskrit: ā me vacāṁsy udyatā dyumattamāni kartvā | ubhā yātaṁ nāsatyā sajoṣasā prati havyāni vītaye ||
english: My words are raised up, most glorious in their working; come, both of you, Nāsatyas, together delighting, to accept the oblations.

sanskrit: rātiṁ yad vām arakṣasaṁ havāmahe yuvābhyāṁ vājinīvasū | prācīṁ hotrām pratirāntāv itaṁ narā gṛṇānā jamadagninā ||
english: When we call upon the demon-free gift of you two, O Vājinīvasus, come, O lords, prolonging the eastern invocation, praised by Jamadagni.

sanskrit: ā no yajñaṁ divispṛśaṁ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ | antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno 'yaṁ śukro ayāmi te ||
english: Come, O Vāyu, to our sacrifice that touches the sky, with good intentions; this bright one, being purified within above, is offered to you.

sanskrit: vety adhvaryuḥ pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ prati havyāni vītaye | adhā niyutva ubhayasya naḥ piba śuciṁ somaṁ gavāśiram ||
english: The adhvaryu goes by the straightest paths to receive the oblations; so now, O lord of the team, drink of both our peoples the pure soma mingled with milk.

sanskrit: baṇ mahām̐ asi sūrya baḻ āditya mahām̐ asi | mahas te sato mahimā panasyate 'ddhā deva mahām̐ asi ||
english: Verily great are you, O Sūrya; verily great are you, O Āditya; the greatness of you the great one is praised; truly, O god, you are great.

sanskrit: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahām̐ asi satrā deva mahām̐ asi | mahnā devānām asurya puroḥito vibhu jyotir adābhyam ||
english: Verily great are you, O Sūrya, in renown; great, O god, are you in every way; mighty among the gods, you are the Asura, the purohita, the all-pervading, indestructible light.

sanskrit: iyaṁ yā nīcy arkiṇī rūpā rohiṇyā kṛtā | citreva praty adarśy āyaty antar daśasu bāhuṣu ||
english: This one, the ray-bearing one of downward form, fashioned after Rohiṇī — like a wondrous thing she is seen appearing, coming amid the ten arms.

sanskrit: prajā ha tisro atyāyam īyur ny anyā arkam abhito viviśre | bṛhad dha tasthau bhuvaneṣv antaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa ||
english: Three offspring have passed beyond; other ones have entered on every side around the sun; the mighty one has stood within the worlds, the purified one has entered into the green.

sanskrit: mātā rudrāṇāṁ duhitā vasūnāṁ svasāadityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra nu vocaṁ cikituṣe janāya mā gām anāgām aditiṁ vadhiṣṭa ||
english: She is the mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Ādityas, the navel of immortality — I now proclaim this to the discerning people: do not slay the guiltless cow Aditi.

sanskrit: vacovidaṁ vācam udīrayantīṁ viśvābhir dhībhir upatiṣṭhamānām | devīṁ devebhyaḥ pary eyuṣīṁ gām ā māvṛkta martyo dabhrācetāḥ ||
english: The cow, who knows speech and who utters speech, who is present with all insights, divine, who has gone around among the gods — let no mortal of small wit snatch her away.

sanskrit: tvam agne bṛhad vayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe | kavir gṛhapatiryuvā ||
english: You, O Agni, bestow great wealth on the worshipper, O god — you the seer, the householder, the ever-young.

sanskrit: sa na īḻānayā saha devāmag̃ agne duvasyuvā | cikid vibhānav ā vaha ||
english: So bring the gods to us along with their praise, O Agni, you who serve them well; bring them, O all-illumining one, that we may know.

sanskrit: tvayā ha svid yujā vayaṁ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya | abhi ṣmo vājasātaye ||
english: With you indeed as our ally, the greatest impeller, O youngest one, we strive for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: aurvabhṛguvac chucim apnavānavad ā huve | agniṁ samudravāsasam ||
english: Like Aurva and Bhṛgu, like Apnavāna, I invoke the pure Agni, who has the ocean as his garment.

sanskrit: huve vātasvanaṁ kavim parjanyakrandyaṁ sahaḥ | agniṁ samudravāsasam ||
english: I invoke the power that sounds like wind, the seer that roars like Parjanya — Agni, who has the ocean as his garment.

sanskrit: ā savaṁ savitur yathā bhagasyeva bhujiṁ huve | agniṁ samudravāsasam ||
english: As the invigorating impulse of Savitṛ, as the enjoyment of Bhaga, so I invoke him — Agni, who has the ocean as his garment.

sanskrit: agniṁ vo vṛdhantam adhvarāṇām purūtamam | acchā naptre sahasvate ||
english: Agni, who grows great through sacrifices, the most glorified of all — sing to his vigorous grandson.

sanskrit: ayaṁ yathā na ābhuvat tvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā | asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ ||
english: Just as Tvaṣṭar comes to us, fashioning forms as things to be shaped — through the will of this glorious one.

sanskrit: ayaṁ viśvā abhi śriyo 'gnir deveṣu patyate | ā vājair upa no gamat ||
english: This Agni reigns over all glories among the gods; may he come to us with prizes.

sanskrit: viśveṣām iha stuhi hotṝṇāṁ yaśastamam | agniṁ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||
english: Praise here among all the priests the most glorious, Agni, the foremost at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: śīram pāvakaśociṣaṁ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣv ā | dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ ||
english: The sharp one with purifying flame, the eldest who shines within the houses — of widest fame, he blazes.

sanskrit: tam arvantaṁ na sānasim gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam | mitraṁ na yātayajjanam ||
english: Praise him, O sage, like a prize-winning steed, the vigorous one — like Mitra, who unites people.

sanskrit: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīr haviṣkṛtaḥ | vāyor anīke asthiran ||
english: The sister hymns, pointing out the oblation-maker, have stood before you at the face of Vāyu.

sanskrit: yasya tridhātv avṛtam barhis tasthāv asaṁdinam | āpaś cin ni dadhā padam ||
english: His three-layer strewn barhis stands without suture; even the waters have placed their foot on it.

sanskrit: padaṁ devasya mīḻhuṣo 'nādhṛṣṭābhir ūtibhiḥ | bhadrā sūrya ivopa dṛk ||
english: The footstep of the bounteous god, with irresistible aids — auspicious is the sight, like the sun.

sanskrit: agne ghṛtasya dhītibhis tepāno deva śociṣā | ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
english: O Agni, blazing with your flame through the layers of ghee, O god — bring the gods hither and worship them.

sanskrit: taṁ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṁ devāso aṅgiraḥ | havyavāham amartyam ||
english: The mothers gave birth to you, the seer; the gods, the Aṅgirases — to you the immortal conveyor of oblations.

sanskrit: pracetasaṁ tvā kave 'gne dūtaṁ vareṇyam | havyavāhaṁ ni ṣedire ||
english: You, the wise one, the most excellent, the desirable messenger, the conveyor of oblations — they have established you, O Agni the seer.

sanskrit: nahi me asty aghnyā na svadhitir vanavnati | athaitādṛg bhharāmi te ||
english: I have no milch-cow, no axe that bites wood; yet I bring you such an offering as this.

sanskrit: yad agne kāni kāni cid ā te dārūṇi dadhmasi | tā juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
english: Whatever pieces of wood we lay down for you, O Agni — be pleased with them, O youngest one.

sanskrit: yad atty upajihvikā yad vamro atisarpati | sarvaṁ tad astu te ghṛtam ||
english: What the little tongue-flame devours, what the ant creeps along — let all of that be ghee for you.

sanskrit: agnim indhāno manasā dhiyaṁ saceta martyaḥ | agnim īdhe vivasvabhiḥ ||
english: The mortal who kindles Agni with his mind shall join his thought to insight; he kindles Agni with his illuminations.

sanskrit: adarśi gātuvittamo yasmin vratāny ādaduḥ | upo ṣu jātam āryasya vardhanam agniṁ nakṣanta no giraḥ ||
english: He has appeared, the most knowing of ways, in whom they have placed their holy observances; may our hymns approach Agni, born to magnify the noble man.

sanskrit: pra daivodāso agnir devāmg̃ acchā na majmanā | anu mātaram pṛthivīṁ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||
english: Daivodāsa's fire goes toward the gods in its greatness like a divine gift; he has turned, following mother Earth, and stands upon the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: yasmād rejanta kṛṣṭayaś carkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ | sahasrasām medhasātāv iva tmanāgniṁ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||
english: At whose deeds, as he performs his powerful works, the peoples tremble — worship Agni by yourselves with thoughts, as in a gain-bringing sacrifice for a thousand.

sanskrit: pra yaṁ rāye ninīṣasi marto yas te vaso dāśat | sa vīraṁ dhatte agna ukthaśaṁsinaṁ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam ||
english: The mortal whom you lead on to wealth, O Vasu, whoever has offered to you — that man by himself possesses a hero, O Agni, who recites the laud, a nourisher of thousands.

sanskrit: sa dṛḻhe cid abhi tṛṇatti vājam arvatā sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ | tve devatrā sadā purūvaso viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
english: He breaks through even the hard place and wins the prize with his steed; he obtains imperishable renown; in you, ever among the gods, O Purūvasu, may we lay up all good things.

sanskrit: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām | madhor na pātrā prathamāny asmai pra stomā yanty agnaye ||
english: He who as hotr distributes all wealth, the charming one of the folk — as the first cups of the sweet drink go to him, so praises go forth to Agni.

sanskrit: aśvaṁ na gīrbhī rathyaṁ sudānavo marmṛjyante devayavaḥ | ubhe toke tanaye dasma viśpate parṣi rādho maghonām ||
english: Like a chariot horse with hymns the bountiful, god-loving ones groom him; O wondrous lord of the settlement, carry across to both progeny and offspring the wealth of the generous.

sanskrit: pra maṁhiṣṭhāya gāyata ṛtāvne bṛhate śukraśociṣe | upastutāso agnaye ||
english: Sing forth to the most bounteous one, the upholder of truth, the great, the bright-flaming — you who stand in praise before Agni.

sanskrit: ā vaṁsate maghavā vīravad yaśaḥ samiddho dyu mny āhutaḥ | kuvin no asya sumatir navīyasy acchā vājebhir āgamat ||
english: When kindled and invoked with oblations, the magnanimous one wins heroic renown; may his newest good will come toward us with prizes.

sanskrit: preṣṭham u priyāṇāṁ stuhy āsāvātithim | agniṁ rathānāṁ yamam ||
english: Praise the most beloved among dear things, the ever-present guest — Agni, the controller of chariots.

sanskrit: uditā yo niditā veditā vasv ā yajñiyo vavartati | duṣṭarā yasya pravaṇe normayo dhiyā vājaṁ siṣāsataḥ ||
english: He who, praiseworthy, turns back toward good things whether praised or blamed — the one who would win the prize with insight: his billows in the deep channel are hard to cross.

sanskrit: mā no hṛṇītām atithir vasur agniḥ pupraśasta eṣaḥ | yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ ||
english: May Agni, the wealth-bearing guest, this one widely praised, not be angry with us — he who is the good hotr, the auspicious sacrificer.

sanskrit: mo te riṣan ye achoktibhir vaso 'gne kebhiś cid evaiḥ | kīriś cid dhi tvām īṭṭe dūtyāya rātahavyaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
english: May those who address you, O Agni, O Vasu, with direct words through whatever ordinances, not be harmed; for even the poet implores you as messenger — he whose offerings are given, who sacrifices well.

sanskrit: āgne yāhi marutsakhā rudrebhiḥ somapītaye | sobharyā upa suṣṭutim mādayasva svarṇare ||
english: Come, O Agni, with the Maruts as companions, with the Rudras, to drink the soma; rejoice, O bull of heaven, at Sobhari's excellent praise.
